Name: Quirinius
Summary: Quirinius (spelled Cyrenius in the King James Version) was governor of Syria at the time of the census that brought Joseph and Mary to Bethlehem for Jesus' birth.
KeyStory: Luke ties the census of Jesus' birth to the governorship of Cyrenius in Syria.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Mary, Mother of Jesus; Joseph, Husband of Mary; Caesar Augustus
LifeLesson: Luke names names and offices because the birth he reports is history. The details invite checking, not blind trust.
